name: astian-mail
description: Astian Mail, Your email, calendar, and contacts. All in one place..

scripts.init: npm run download && npm run import && npm run bootstrap
scripts.brand:release: amelia set brand release && npm run import
scripts.build:linux-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 npm run build
scripts.build:linux-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 npm run build
scripts.build:mac-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 npm run build
scripts.build:mac-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 npm run build
scripts.build:win-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 ASTIAN_CROSS_COMPILING=true npm run build
scripts.build:win-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 ASTIAN_CROSS_COMPILING=true npm run build
scripts.package:linux-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 npm run package
scripts.package:linux-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 npm run package
scripts.package:mac-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 npm run package
scripts.package:mac-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 npm run package
scripts.package:win-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 ASTIAN_CROSS_COMPILING=true npm run package
scripts.package:win-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 ASTIAN_CROSS_COMPILING=true npm run package
